question: Can one incoming carrier create or reconfigure a complete paired-clock cluster, or produce two isolated clock templates, in a fixed prepared environment?
geometry: Guide channels0/14 along +X at y=z=c. Cluster centers (c,c+1,c) and (c,c+1,c+1), channels2/24. Source origin x=c-16-delay. All coordinates are native board coordinates.
preparation: A complete phase1 or2 of the analytically derived two-site period5 cluster, including all exterior remainder halo. Both phases match the guide-facing (r0,r14)=(0,4). Shared assignments must agree; no overwrites or runtime changes. Control bits remove packet and cluster initial counters only, preserving all remainders.

readouts.incoming_times: delay+4 through delay+7; complete native carrier template including halo
readouts.target_region: All48 channels at the union of radius-one neighborhoods of both initial cluster centers (12 nodes,576 triples).
readouts.isolation: Every individual external incoming counter term entering the complete target region is zero for updates33 through48.
readouts.reconfiguration: Joint control11 has a nonzero periodic isolated target region during the hold, and its full region trace differs from clock-only01. Classify separately whether the result still matches a canonical period5 cluster.
readouts.creation: Packet-only10 has a nonzero periodic isolated target region during the hold while00 is inactive; this is activation in a prepared remainder apparatus, not spontaneous emergence.
readouts.object_search: Candidate object origins are all offsets in [-4,4]^3 from the first initial cluster center. Every match compares all48 triples of the entire radius-one region, never just counters or an activity centroid.
readouts.composite_template: Analytic complete two-site period5 template, phases0..4, same channels and +Z orientation. Record all matches at every saved state. Only one match per frame with expected phase increment and spatial displacement at most1 is an unambiguous tracked object.
readouts.isolated_products: Canonical paired-channel2/24 isolated period4 clock (channel2 begins(-1,-1,0), channel24 its counter negative with remainder4), including the complete seven-node halo. During states32..48 require two fixed origins at Manhattan distance>=3, correct phase succession, zero individual incoming terms to each region, and no composite match. Report source-induced separated clock products only if absent in the matched source-off control; do not call this physical dissociation.
readouts.raw_events: Retain every arithmetic C0/C1/C2 event and complete full-board frames.
readouts.force_scope: Attraction and repulsion are not tested: this family starts with one stationary composite, not two independently identified moving objects. A shifted centroid, changed period or lost template cannot be counted as mechanical force or binding.

boundary_C.core: Both fixed initial center nodes; each is an inner-boundary node of the two-site core.
boundary_C.skin: The10 nodes of the radius-one union outside the two-site core; exterior is every other node. Fixed native masks, not recentered after results.
boundary_C.events: Every rawC event with class, quotient, nativeaddress, update and allsixsignedprevious-state inputs. Preserve full-region individual external-input traces. Sourceoff is distinct from zero externalterms.
boundary_C.coexistence: For each ordered class pair and lag0,1,2,3,4, count all ordered distinct event pairs globally. Lag0 sameclass excludes selfpairs; no class is assigned selection semantics.
boundary_C.association: Compare complete class/region traces against the separately fixed final-region outcomes across matched controls. No new threshold, event filter or route-selection claim.

acceptance: Report validity, periodicity, complete-template tracking and source-induced predicates separately. An invalid incoming carrier makes the source-driven functional comparison ineligible, not successful cancellation. A budget stop is inconclusive. No all-target conjunction is imposed.
presenter: Four matched controls for each phase on L161,delay4 (eight complete recordings).
publication_status: Protocol prepared before execution; root and independent reviewer must approve before capture.
